items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: he told me, don't play so you want me to play more like Higgy or somebody more rough.

ctx.x: You think Roy Palmer played more trombone than you?

Well I think I'll give you an answer to that. I've been hearing Roy's records. I'll say this. Roy always could play better. Willie Humphrey said last night that George Field told him that Roy always was exact in playing trombone. No, I think Roy shaded me in musicianship for one thing, because Roy could read all the clefs. You see what I'm talking about? And I can. I'm just being truthful about it. But now I'm more aggressive than Roy was. It's a change of times. You see I had fellas tell me, I don't want you to…
Well he had a funny attack sometimes. But then other times he could play very clean. His brakes were extremely clean. Yeah, yeah.
